notes.provisional: Keys not measured on an oriole yet. tools/mkpayload.py refuses to build an XNU payload while this list is not empty. Each key leaves the list only with a probe-run label (docs/PORT.md).
notes.dram_banks: GUESS from FDT node names memory@80000000, memory@880000000, memory@900000000, memory@980000000 (observed via adb ls /proc/device-tree on 2026-11-11, Android CP1A.260405.005, bootloader slider-16.4-14548185; sizes need root) and ro.boot.hardware.ddr=8GiB: 4 x 2 GiB, the high three contiguous and merged here. Measure with the probe's 'FDT memory' section.
notes.xnu_ram: Deliberately the same 4 GiB window as bluejay (the XNU memory path is observed only with this size); it must lie inside a hole-free bank with no reserved range inside. Growing it to 6 GiB is a later, separate change.
notes.fb_base: read from source: mainline Linux gs101-oriole.dts cont_splash_mem reg <0x0 0xfac00000 (1080*2400*4)>, framebuffer0 width 1080 height 2400 stride 1080*4 a8r8g8b8. Provisional until the probe shim's text is seen on the oriole screen.
notes.usb_dma_range: FDT node reserved-memory/abl@f8800000 exists (observed by name via adb, 2026-11-11); the size 16 MiB is bluejay's. Measure with the probe's 'FDT reserved abl@f8800000' lines and 'USB EVBUF in reserved abl@f8800000'.
notes.key_pins: read from source: same gpio-keys as bluejay. Google raviole gs101-oriole-common.dtsi -> gs101-raviole.dtsi:8 includes gs101/gs101-common.dtsi (bluejay: gs101-bluejay.dtsi:8, the same file); mainline gs101-pixel-common.dtsi gpio-keys (gpa7-3, gpa8-1, gpa10-1, GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW) is the oriole tree. Bank offsets as in device/google/bluejay/board.json notes.
notes.touch: read from source: Google kernel/devices/google/raviole android-gs-raviole-6.1-android16 dts/gs101-oriole-touch.dtsi (st,dchip_id 0x36 0x48, st,max-coords 1079 2399, firmware ftm5_fw_o6.ftb) includes gs101/gs101-fts-touch.dtsi (st,irq-gpio gpa9 0, st,reset-gpio gpp26 0, CS gpp23-3, spi-max-frequency 10 MHz), which includes gs101-common-touch.dtsi:8-15 (SPI gpp23-0..2, TS_SPI_SEL gpp26-1, DVDD LDO25M, AVDD LDO26M). Same files as bluejay; only the panel map and IC firmware name differ.
